subject: SI Cohort Promo Fuel — allocation, telemetry & manifest
messages:
From: Bethany Moore <bethany@stratussi.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: Jason Park <jason@cloudloop.io>
Date: 2026-09-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SI cohort promo fuel for Q4 cohort

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well — we’re starting a new SI-led accelerator cohort the week of Oct 4 and would like to request promotional credits from Redwood to seed the POCs. High level: 10 SI customers, each will run a 2‑week POC (expected peak token use ~30k per POC).

Ask:
- 5,000 USD worth of trial credits (redeemable as tokens) to split across the cohort, with voucher expirations on 12/31/2026.
- A CSV manifest with voucher codes and simple redemption instructions we can give to customers.
- Telemetry hooks or usage tags so we can report back on conversion.

Attached: cohort_manifest.xlsx (customer list + POC profiles).

Is this something Redwood can approve on a Partner Promo allocation? If helpful, Jason (copied) is running the accelerator day-to-day.

Thanks — Bethany
Bethany Moore
Sr. Partner Lead | Stratus Systems
[Attachment: cohort_manifest.xlsx (XLSX)]
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Bethany Moore <bethany@stratussi.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SI cohort promo fuel for Q4 cohort

Hi Bethany — thanks for the details and the manifest. This looks reasonable.

Next steps I propose:
1) Vanessa — can you validate the voucher cadence and confirm we can generate time‑bounded codes for 10 customers (expiry 12/31/2026)?
2) Karthik — please confirm the typical per‑POC window and whether a single voucher per SI customer is preferable or individual customer vouchers.
3) Once Ops confirms, I’ll loop in Finance for the promotional allocation sign-off and DocuSign for the terms.

Bethany — quick Q: do you need the vouchers as single‑use codes or a pooled allocation for each SI? That affects how we format the manifest.

— Jonas
Jonas Weber
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>

Jonas / Bethany — tagging in Ops and Finance. Quick summary of what Ops can deliver and recommended format: 

What we can provide:
- 10 single‑use voucher codes (one per SI customer) totaling $5,000 USD in face value (breakdown in attached CSV).
- Expiry set to 2026-12-31; codes are redeemable only for Redwood hosted inference usage (tokens + embeddings) and flagged as partner_promo in telemetry.
- We can add a partner tag in reporting so Stratus gets a weekly usage digest during the cohort.

Constraints / notes:
- Single‑use codes are easiest for audit; if Stratus needs pooled credits we can do per‑SI allocations but redemption tracking will be coarser.
- We’ll require a signed promo agreement for accounting (DocuSign link below) to reconcile the promotional spend.

Attached: promo_alloc.csv (CSV with code, value, expiry, redemption_url).

DocuSign (draft): https://docusign.com/sign/ABC123-redwood-voucher-agreement
Ops contact: Vanessa Ortiz, Partner Operations

Bethany — if that works I’ll mark this as ready for Finance approval and send the finalized manifest.

[Attachment: promo_alloc.csv (CSV)]

- SLA exception: granted for one cohort, do not extend automatically without a new request.
- Telemetry: Vanessa — please enable partner_promo tag and weekly digest for Stratus for the duration of the cohort.

Bethany — once you sign the DocuSign, we’ll deliver the codes and a short how‑to for customers.

Thanks — Michael
